title: eludite.agents.provider_models output
description: The server's models, sorted by id (case folded), with their context windows when the server reports them (llama.cpp's `meta.n_ctx_train`, OpenRouter's `context_length`) or the catalog gives them.

id.description: The model id the server takes in `model`.

name.description: The name the model picker shows; the id when absent.

contextWindow.description: The model's context window in tokens; 0 or absent: unknown (the usage strip shows no bar).

listing.description: `server`: from `GET /models`; `catalog`: the provider's own list (the server does not list models, or was not asked); `none`: no list (see `message`).

message.description: Why there is no list: `the key was rejected (401)`, `this server does not list models`, `could not reach the server: ...`, `the server answered 500: ...`.
